title: Exact greeting
prompt: Make `program()` print exactly `Hello, world!` (one line). Every character counts — capital H, comma, exclamation mark.

tests.name: greets-world
tests.code:
string outText = Cj.Capture(() => Solution.program());
Cj.Eq(outText, "Hello, world!\n", "output");
tests.hint: The output must be exactly `Hello, world!` (with the newline WriteLine adds).
